abstract: This study analyzes how hiring standards, entry wages, and hiring costs are associated with labor market tightness. Using unique linked employer-employee data for small- and medium-sized firms in Germany, we find that pre-match search costs represent only 16 percent of total hiring expenditures, while post-match costs account for the remaining 84 percent. Instrumental variable regressions show no evidence that tighter labor markets are associated with higher entry wages. Instead, we find differences along two non-wage dimensions. First, firms hire workers whose general ability is lower relative to their existing workforce. Second, firms incur higher post-match hiring costs for these hires. A one standard deviation increase in labor market tightness is associated with a 0.1 standard deviation decrease in hiring standards, an 11 percent longer adaptation period, and 15 percent higher informal training hours for new hires. These findings suggest that, in tight labor markets, variation in hiring outcomes is reflected more strongly in hiring standards and post-hire training investments than in entry wages.
title: Beggars cannot be choosers: Labor market tightness, hiring standards, wages, and hiring costs

abstract: We analyse growth vulnerability in the four largest Euro Area (EA) economies, measured as a lower quantile of the growth distribution conditional on EA‐wide and country‐specific macroeconomic/financial factors. Growth densities are obtained under a normal activity scenario and under stressed conditions. We find that vulnerability is higher in Germany, more exposed to EA‐wide conditions, and in Spain, with large country‐specific dynamics. Under stress, financial factors amplify adverse macroeconomic conditions, and even severe individual shocks fail to fully explain the vulnerability observed under systemic stress. Our results underscore the importance of monitoring local and EA‐wide macro‐financial conditions to mitigate vulnerability.
abstract_zh: 我们分析欧元区四大经济体的增长脆弱性，其衡量方式为在欧元区整体及国别特定宏观经济/金融因素条件下增长分布的下分位数。增长密度是在正常活动情景和压力条件下得到的。我们发现，德国的脆弱性更高，对欧元区整体状况的暴露更大；西班牙的脆弱性也较高，并具有显著的国家特定动态。在压力情景下，金融因素会放大不利的宏观经济条件，甚至严重的个体冲击也无法完全解释系统性压力下所观察到的脆弱性。我们的结果凸显了监测地方和欧元区整体宏观金融状况以缓解脆弱性的重要性。

abstract: We conduct an artefactual field experiment in real-existing trade networks to analyze how individual network degree affects bargaining demands and outcomes. We combine data from a bilateral bargaining experiment with data of trade networks in 24 villages in Uganda. To identify the effect of individual degree in the village trade network we experimentally vary the disclosure of participants’ identities in a bargaining pair. We derive hypotheses on how degree should affect behavior and find partial support for them. Specifically, we observe that individual degree affects bargaining demands in the predicted direction when one of the bargainers is informed about the network positions but not when both sides are informed. Moreover, network degree affects the likelihood of agreements and earnings, irrespective of the knowledge of the network positions of bargaining partners.
abstract_zh: 我们在真实存在的贸易网络中开展了一项人工实地实验，以分析个体网络度如何影响议价要求与结果。我们将双边议价实验的数据与乌干达24个村庄的贸易网络数据相结合。为了识别村庄贸易网络中个体度的影响，我们通过实验操作议价对中参与者身份的披露情况。我们提出了关于度应如何影响行为的假设，并发现这些假设得到了部分支持。具体而言，我们观察到，当议价双方中只有一方知晓网络位置信息时，个体度对议价要求的影响方向符合预测；但当双方都知晓时，这一影响则不显著。此外，无论议价对手的网络位置是否被知晓，网络度都会影响达成协议的可能性及收益。

abstract: This paper investigates how peer firms' Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR)-related incidents influence the corporate investment efficiency of non-incident firms. Using a sample of U.S. firms from 2007 to 2021, we document a significant increase in investment-Tobin's Q sensitivity following negative peer events, thereby improving investment efficiency. We identify three non-mutually exclusive channels. First, the effect is stronger among firms with higher analyst coverage, greater stock trading volume, and closer product-market proximity to the incident firm, consistent with the notion of heightened external scrutiny. Second, peer incidents serve as informational shocks that enhance managerial learning from external signals, particularly when firms operate in competitive industries, face high product-market uncertainty, or have more informative stock prices. Furthermore, we find that the performance of focal firms deteriorates following peer incidents and that efficiency gains are greater among firms that were previously overinvesting. Taken together, these findings suggest that peer CSR scandals act as disciplining and learning events that improve investment behavior across the industry.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了同行企业的企业社会责任（CSR）相关事件如何影响非事件企业的投资效率。利用2007年至2021年美国企业样本，我们发现负面同行事件后，投资-托宾Q敏感度显著提升，从而改善了投资效率。我们识别出三个非互斥的传导渠道。首先，在分析师覆盖度更高、股票交易量更大以及与事件企业产品市场距离更近的企业中，该效应更为显著，这与外部监督加强的观点一致。其次，同行事件作为信息冲击，增强了管理层从外部信号中学习的能力，尤其是在竞争激烈行业、面临高产品市场不确定性或股价信息含量更高的企业中表现突出。此外，我们发现，同行事件后焦点企业绩效下滑，且效率提升在先前过度投资的企业中更为显著。综合来看，这些发现表明，同行企业社会责任丑闻起到了纪律约束和学习事件的作用，从而改善了整个行业的投资行为。
title: When peers fail: Spillover effects of CSR incidents on real investment
title_zh: 当同行失败时：企业社会责任事件对实际投资的溢出效应

abstract: Fund managers cast votes that are more critical of firm environmental and social (ES) practices when the firm has operations located close to fund headquarters. This elevated support for shareholder ES proposals is not mirrored in governance proposals, which likely have less impact on the local community. We find similar pro-ES fund voting practices at firms with operations near the fund manager’s college and prior employment locations and in utility companies that provide electric and gas service to the fund’s address. Manager and sub-advisor turnover events provide additional evidence: tracking the same decision-maker’s votes at a fixed set of firms before and after the move, we find that support for ES proposals increases significantly once the manager gains proximity to those firms. The proximity effect is concentrated at high-polluting plants, consistent with managers responding to personal exposure to environmental harm. We conclude that fund managers exhibit a personal bias in ES voting, being more likely to support ES proposals that impact them personally.
abstract_zh: 当企业运营地点邻近基金总部时，基金经理投出的票更倾向于对企业环境与社会（ES）实践持批评态度。这种对股东ES提案支持度的提升并未在治理提案中体现，后者对当地社区的影响可能较小。我们发现，在企业运营地点靠近基金经理的大学及先前工作地点，以及向基金地址提供电力和燃气服务的公用事业公司中，也存在类似的亲ES基金投票行为。经理及副顾问更替事件提供了额外证据：追踪同一决策者在固定企业集合中迁移前后的投票情况，我们发现一旦经理获得与这些企业的邻近性，对ES提案的支持度显著增加。邻近效应集中在高污染工厂，这与经理因个人接触环境损害而作出反应相符。我们得出结论，基金经理在ES投票中表现出个人偏见，更倾向于支持那些对其个人有影响的ES提案。
title: Not in my backyard: Personal bias in mutual fund voting on environmental and social proposals

abstract: This paper develops and tests a life-cycle hypothesis of sleep investment. Motivated by evidence from psychology, aging, and sleep research that the consequences of insufficient sleep become increasingly severe with age, we argue that individuals facing stronger productivity incentives should increasingly preserve sleep as they age. We formalize this idea in a simple life-cycle framework in which sleep is a productive activity that competes with work and leisure for time. We test the framework using longitudinal data from the National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent to Adult Health (Add Health). We focus on adolescent physical attractiveness and college education as two characteristics associated with occupational sorting and long-run productivity incentives. While both characteristics exhibit little association with sleep duration in early adulthood, their relationships with sleep become increasingly positive over the life cycle. Attractive individuals and college graduates experience substantially less negative declines in sleep duration with age and increasingly sleep longer relative to their counterparts in later adulthood. Additional analyses show that these patterns are strongest among workers and are not readily explained by mental health, sleep difficulties, social participation, or reverse causality through sleep affecting later attractiveness. More broadly, the findings suggest that differences in long-run productivity incentives contribute to divergent sleep trajectories over adulthood and support a life-cycle perspective on sleep investment.
abstract_zh: 本文构建并检验了睡眠投资的生命周期假说。基于心理学、老龄化及睡眠研究中的证据——睡眠不足的后果随年龄增长而日益严重——我们认为，面临更强生产力激励的个体应随年龄增长而愈发注重保持睡眠。我们在一个简洁的生命周期框架中形式化这一观点，其中睡眠被视为一种生产性活动，与工作和闲暇争夺时间。我们利用全国青少年至成人健康纵向研究（Add Health）的数据对该框架进行检验，重点关注青少年时期的外貌吸引力和大学教育这两个与职业分流及长期生产力激励相关的特征。尽管这两个特征在成年早期与睡眠时长几乎无关联，但它们与睡眠的关系在生命周期中逐渐转为正向。外貌吸引力较高者及大学毕业生在年龄增长过程中睡眠时长的下降幅度显著较小，并在成年后期相对于其对照群体睡眠时间日益延长。进一步分析显示，这些模式在工作者中最为显著，且无法由心理健康、睡眠障碍、社会参与或睡眠反向影响后期外貌的因果倒置所充分解释。更广泛地，研究结果表明，长期生产力激励的差异促成了成年期睡眠轨迹的分化，并支持了睡眠投资的生命周期视角。
title: Sleeping Investment: A Life-Cycle Hypothesis
title_zh: 沉睡的投资：生命周期假说

abstract: The 2008 financial crisis sparked a massive wave of scholarship reviewing the history of capitalism. To these ambitious narratives of economic history has now been added Trevor Jackson's The Insatiable Machine. Distinguishing itself in a crowded field, Jackson's incisive book covers the history of capitalism's global dominance in just over 300 pages, in which he seeks to explain ‘where capitalism came from, how it spread around the world, and how it came to be the dominant way of organizing human lives’ (p. 2).

abstract: Whether cultural heritage protection can preserve historical and cultural resources while expanding county-level consumption market activity is important for understanding the economic effects of cultural policy. Using county-level panel data from China for 2000–2019, this paper exploits the staggered designation of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units and applies a staggered difference-in-differences approach. The results show that heritage protection significantly increases county-level retail-based consumption activity, and the finding remains robust across multiple checks. Mechanism analysis shows that local fiscal expenditure, infrastructure investment, fixed-asset investment, service-sector expansion, tourist flows, service-sector employment, and land-value capitalization change in directions consistent with the theoretical predictions. These results suggest that heritage protection may expand county-level consumption market activity through supply-side improvements and demand-side expansion, including tourist spending and broader local market responses. Heterogeneity analysis indicates that the effect is mainly concentrated in counties in central and western China, non-core administrative counties, and smaller counties. This paper provides evidence on the local market effects of cultural heritage protection and offers policy implications for activating cultural resources in less developed areas.
abstract_zh: 文化遗产保护能否在保存历史文化资源的同时扩大县域消费市场活力，对于理解文化政策的经济效应具有重要意义。本文利用2000-2019年中国县域面板数据，基于全国重点文物保护单位的分批认定政策，采用交错双重差分法进行实证分析。研究结果表明，文化遗产保护显著提升了县域零售消费活力，该结论在多项稳健性检验中依然成立。机制分析显示，地方财政支出、基础设施投资、固定资产投资、服务业扩张、旅游客流、服务业就业及土地价值资本化等指标的变化方向均与理论预期一致。这些发现表明，文化遗产保护可能通过供给侧改善与需求侧扩张（包括旅游消费及更广泛的地方市场响应）来扩大县域消费市场活力。异质性分析显示，该效应主要集中在中西部地区、非核心行政县及规模较小的县域。本文为文化遗产保护的本地市场效应提供了实证证据，并为激活欠发达地区文化资源提供了政策启示。

abstract: This study investigates whether luxury watches offer diversification benefits as alternative investment assets. Using the stochastic dominance method, we aim to provide robust statistical evidence of the safe-haven properties of Rolex watches. Our analysis shows that for risk-averse investors, the Rolex index stochastically dominates traditional alternatives, including gold, Bitcoin, and equities. This dominance is primarily driven by superior price stability, extreme positive skewness, and limited downside risk, rather than simply the mean return. We identify an optimal portfolio allocation consisting of 65–70% Rolex watches and the remainder in gold. This diversified strategy yields a superior risk-return profile, lies on the efficient frontier, and achieves first-order stochastic dominance over a pure Rolex position. This research contributes to the literature by extending the stochastic dominance framework to physical luxury collectables for the first time and highlighting the critical role of distributional properties, such as low tail risk and positive skewness, in determining asset dominance.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨奢侈品手表作为另类投资资产是否具备分散化投资优势。通过随机占优方法，我们旨在为劳力士手表的避险属性提供稳健的统计证据。分析表明，对于风险厌恶型投资者而言，劳力士指数在随机占优意义上优于黄金、比特币及股票等传统替代资产。这种优势主要源于其卓越的价格稳定性、极端正偏态分布特征以及有限的下行风险，而非单纯的平均收益率差异。我们识别出由65%-70%劳力士手表与剩余黄金构成的最优投资组合配置。该分散化策略呈现出更优的风险收益特征，位于有效前沿曲线上，并实现对纯劳力士头寸的一阶随机占优。本研究首次将随机占优框架拓展至实体奢侈品收藏品领域，揭示了低尾部风险与正偏态等分布特征在决定资产占优性中的关键作用，为相关文献作出贡献。
title: Beyond gold and Bitcoin: stochastic dominance evidence for Rolex watches as an elite safe-haven asset
title_zh: 超越黄金与比特币：劳力士手表作为精英避险资产的随机占优证据

abstract: This paper investigates how Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) relate to school efficiency, drawing on data from the OECD PISA 2022 survey for 5,360 schools across 21 EU countries. We estimate school-level efficiency scores using a robust nonparametric order-m model under a meta-frontier framework, distinguishing between local (within-country) and global (cross-country) benchmarks. We also run a robust conditional efficiency model in which exogenous variables are indicators of ICT availability and use, showing how ICT is associated with an increase in average efficiency. We also employ a multilevel random forest model to explore which ICT-related variables best explain efficiency scores. Findings highlight that cognitively engaging digital activities such as student-led research, data analysis, and the use of digital learning games are positively associated with efficiency, especially when used in moderation (i.e. avoiding its excessive use).
abstract_zh: 本文利用OECD PISA 2022调查中21个欧盟国家5360所学校的数据，探究信息通信技术（ICT）与学校效率之间的关系。我们采用元前沿框架下的稳健非参数order-m模型估算学校层面的效率得分，区分了本地（国家内部）与全球（跨国）基准。同时，我们运行了稳健的条件效率模型，将ICT可用性与使用指标作为外生变量，揭示ICT如何与平均效率提升相关联。此外，我们运用多层随机森林模型，探索哪些ICT相关变量最能解释效率得分差异。研究结果表明：以学生主导研究、数据分析及数字学习游戏为代表的认知参与型数字活动与效率呈正相关，尤其在适度使用（即避免过度使用）时效果更为显著。
title: How does ICT relate to school efficiency in Europe? Evidence from OECD PISA 2022
title_zh: ICT如何影响欧洲学校效率？基于OECD PISA 2022的证据

abstract: This study employs a TVP-VAR method and wavelet analysis to investigate the risk linkages and volatility spillovers between energy and stock markets. The key findings are as follows. First, significant risk spillovers exist between the international energy market and the Chinese stock market, with volatility predominantly driven by long-term components. Moreover, these dynamic spillovers tend to intensify during extreme events. Second, energy price fluctuations serve as a leading indicator for stock market risk dynamics. Third, frequency heterogeneity exists between energy and stock markets. From a policy perspective, regulatory authorities should improve the macro-regulatory system – by building strategic energy reserves and advancing early warning systems – to bolster financial stability.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用TVP-VAR方法与小波分析，探讨能源市场与股票市场之间的风险关联及波动溢出效应。主要发现如下：第一，国际能源市场与中国股票市场之间存在显著的风险溢出，波动主要由长期成分驱动。此外，此类动态溢出在极端事件期间趋于加剧。第二，能源价格波动可作为股票市场风险动态的先行指标。第三，能源市场与股票市场之间存在频率异质性。从政策视角看，监管机构应完善宏观调节体系——通过构建战略能源储备与推进预警系统建设——以增强金融稳定性。

abstract: This paper examines whether climate risk is associated with excess executive perquisites (perks) among Chinese listed firms over the period 2014–2022. Using a city-level climate risk index based on disaster-related fatalities and economic losses, we find that firms exposed to greater climate risk tend to exhibit higher excess executive perks. This positive association is weaker for firms with greater media coverage and stronger digital technology application. The results remain robust to a range of additional analyses, including alternative climate-risk and perk measures, propensity score matching, first-difference specifications, confounder tests, and Fama – MacBeth regressions. Overall, the paper contributes to the literature on the governance consequences of climate risk by showing that climate-related pressure is associated with greater implicit executive consumption and that stronger external scrutiny and governance-related discipline may mitigate this relation.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了2014-2022年间中国上市公司面临的气候风险是否与超额高管在职消费（perks）存在关联。基于城市层面以灾害相关死亡人数和经济损失构建的气候风险指数，我们发现：面临较高气候风险的企业往往表现出更高的超额高管在职消费水平。媒体关注度较高及数字技术应用较强的企业，这种正向关联会有所减弱。在包括替代性气候风险与在职消费指标、倾向得分匹配、一阶差分模型、混淆变量检验以及Fama-MacBeth回归在内的一系列附加分析中，该结果依然保持稳健。总体而言，本文通过揭示气候相关压力与更高隐性高管消费之间的关联，并论证更强外部监督与治理约束可能缓解这一关系，为气候风险治理后果的相关文献做出了贡献。关键词：气候风险；超额高管在职消费；公司治理；数字技术应用；中国JEL分类：Q54 G34 J33 O33 Q58致谢：我们感谢编辑及三位匿名审稿人在审稿过程中提出的建设性意见。

title: Climate risk and excess executive perquisites: the moderating role of media and digitalization
title_zh: 气候风险与高管超额津贴：媒体与数字化的调节作用

abstract: This study asks whether and how risk connectedness between green bonds and G8 financial markets varies across market states, time, and investment horizons. Using daily data from 2015 to 2025, we apply a TVP-QVAR connectedness framework and wavelet-based analyses to measure quantile-dependent and time-frequency spillovers before and after COVID-19. We find that connectedness is strongest at extreme quantiles, green bonds are mostly net risk receivers but temporarily become transmitters during the pandemic, and European equity markets are key systemic transmitters. Medium-frequency co-movements dominate, whereas long-run coherence weakens after COVID-19. The results show that the diversification and safe-haven roles of green bonds are conditional on market states and horizons.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨绿色债券与八国集团金融市场之间的风险关联性是否以及如何随市场状态、时间及投资期限而变化。基于2015至2025年的日度数据，我们采用TVP-QVAR关联性框架与小波分析方法，测度新冠疫情前后分位数依赖型及时频域风险溢出效应。研究发现：极端分位数下的关联性最强；绿色债券主要充当净风险接收方，但在疫情期间暂时转为风险传递方；欧洲股票市场是关键的系统性风险传递方。中频协同波动占据主导地位，而长期协动性在新冠疫情后有所减弱。结果表明，绿色债券的分散化与避险功能具有市场状态与投资期限的条件依赖性。
title: Multi-scale quantile connectedness effects between green bonds and G8 countries’ financial markets
title_zh: 绿色债券与G8国家金融市场间的多尺度分位数关联效应

abstract: Since the onset of the U.S.–China trade conflict in 2018, the United States has repeatedly imposed import tariffs on Chinese goods, and China has responded with retaliatory measures. Within a deeply interconnected global economy, we examine the role of the third country in shaping the macroeconomic effects of U.S.–China trade conflicts. In particular, when also subject to U.S. import tariffs, how does the third country’s behavior influence the effectiveness of China’s retaliatory measures? Using a three-country DSGE model that includes China, the United States, and the rest of the world (RoW), we find that U.S. tariffs reduce China’s exports to the United States; however, China partially offsets this decline by increasing exports to third-country markets, thereby mitigating the overall adverse effects. Under the U.S. “reciprocal tariff” policy, both China and the third country incur economic losses, and the effectiveness of China’s retaliation depends critically on the third country’s response. If the third country also retaliates, bilateral trade between China and the third country increases significantly, leading to substantial improvements in both economies, while the United States becomes the largest loser due to a deterioration in its global trade position.
abstract_zh: 自2018年中美贸易冲突爆发以来，美国多次对中国商品加征进口关税，中国则采取了相应的反制措施。在深度互联的全球经济背景下，我们考察了第三国在塑造中美贸易冲突宏观经济效应中的作用。特别是，当第三国同样面临美国进口关税时，其行为如何影响中国反制措施的有效性？通过构建一个包含中国、美国及世界其他地区（RoW）的三国DSGE模型，我们发现美国关税减少了中国对美国的出口；然而，中国通过增加对第三国市场的出口部分抵消了这一下降，从而缓解了整体不利影响。在美国“对等关税”政策下，中国和第三国均遭受经济损失，而中国反制措施的有效性关键取决于第三国的反应。若第三国也采取反制措施，中国与第三国之间的双边贸易将显著增加，两国经济均大幅改善，而美国则因全球贸易地位恶化而成为最大输家。

title: U.S.–China trade conflicts and third-country effects
title_zh: 中美贸易冲突与第三国效应

abstract: The combination of ongoing pandemic-related supply chain issues and the commencement of the Ukraine-Russia war triggered a sharp increase in gasoline prices in 2022, occurring alongside a forty-year high in general inflation. In response, five state governments temporarily stopped collecting excise taxes on gasoline in order to provide ‘inflation relief’ to their constituents. In this work, we examine the incidence of this tax relief and assess whether or not the full amount was passed-through to consumers using multiple methodologies in a natural experiment setting. In aggregate, we find that excise tax pass-through was not complete with about 82% of the excise tax relief passed down to consumers, though state-level event-studies show pass-through was likely complete in two states. Our results imply an unintended subsidy to gasoline retailers of approximately $390 million dollars in exchange for only about $10–15 in savings for each driver. The results highlight the need for alternative policy measures.
abstract_zh: 疫情相关的供应链问题持续存在，加之乌克兰-俄罗斯冲突的爆发，导致2022年汽油价格急剧上涨，同时伴随着四十年来的高通胀水平。为应对此情况，五个州政府暂时停止征收汽油消费税，旨在为民众提供“通胀救济”。本研究通过多种方法，在自然实验背景下，考察了这一税收减免的归宿，并评估其是否全额传导至消费者。总体而言，我们发现消费税减免并未完全传导，约有82%的税收减免惠及消费者，尽管州级事件研究显示，其中两个州的传导可能已完全实现。我们的结果暗示，汽油零售商意外获得了约3.9亿美元的补贴，而每位驾驶者仅节省约10至15美元。这些发现凸显了采取替代政策措施的紧迫性。
title: Is inflation relief passed-through? Evidence from excise taxes
title_zh: 通胀减免是否传导？来自消费税的证据

abstract: Large-scale infrastructure investments are often carried out in settings where their eventual usefulness or importance is difficult to predict. This paper studies optimal incentives for investment when the agent undertaking the investment has superior information on two dimensions: the cost of investment and the likelihood it is useful or beneficial to the principal. Usefulness eventually becomes public, but punishments are limited as the regulator aims at ensuring the agent earns non-negative profits in each period. We characterize the optimal incentive scheme and show it involves either: (i) investments by the agent even though he knows they are useless and rents to only cost-efficient types, or (ii) rents to all types. The possibility that rent is left to all types contrasts with the usual prediction in static (and also dynamic) mechanism design and arises even though the agent’s preferences are stable over time.
abstract_zh: 大规模基础设施投资往往在其实用性或重要性难以预测的环境中进行。本文研究了当承担投资的代理人在两个维度上拥有信息优势时的最优激励问题：投资成本以及投资对委托人而言有用或有益的可能性。实用性最终会公开，但由于监管者旨在确保代理人每期获得非负利润，惩罚措施受到限制。我们刻画了最优激励方案，并表明其涉及以下两种情况之一：（i）代理人即使知道投资无用仍进行投资，且仅向成本效率高的类型支付租金；或（ii）向所有类型支付租金。向所有类型留下租金的可能性与静态（以及动态）机制设计中的通常预测形成对比，并且即使在代理人偏好随时间保持稳定的情况下也会出现。
title: Regulating investments when both costs and need are private
title_zh: 当成本和需求均为私人信息时的投资监管

abstract: This paper quantifies the effects of energy price shocks in the euro area and examines the role of ECB monetary policy during the energy crisis. Using a Bayesian VAR identified with sign and narrative restrictions, local projections, and counterfactuals, I show that energy shocks induce persistent and broad-based inflationary pressures while reducing real activity. The pass-through to inflation is state-dependent: it is sizeable and persistent only when inflation is already elevated and when the shock originates from gas and electricity prices. A counterfactual exercise shows that an earlier and more forceful monetary policy tightening would have reduced inflation only at the cost of a sizeable output loss.
abstract_zh: 本文量化了欧元区能源价格冲击的影响，并考察了欧洲央行在能源危机期间的货币政策作用。通过采用基于符号约束与叙事约束识别的贝叶斯向量自回归模型、局部投影法及反事实分析，研究表明能源冲击在抑制实际经济活动的同时，引发了持续且广泛的通胀压力。通胀传导呈现状态依赖性：仅当通胀水平已处于高位且冲击源自天然气与电力价格时，传导效应才显著且持久。反事实模拟显示，若更早实施更强力的货币政策紧缩，虽能降低通胀，但需以显著产出损失为代价。
title: Energy prices, inflation, and the ECB’s monetary policy during the 2021-22 energy crisis
title_zh: 能源价格、通胀与2021-22年能源危机期间欧洲央行的货币政策

abstract: We consider a number of deterministic models of economic growth in which all agents act rationally and the unique perfect foresight equilibrium features a stock price bubble. The key assumptions are that the production technology exhibits decreasing returns to scale (so that firms earn positive profits) and that wage income and dividend income have different growth rates. We relate the latter property to the violation of the Inada conditions for labor. The unique equilibrium fails to satisfy the property of balanced growth.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了一系列确定性经济增长模型，其中所有行为者均理性行动，且唯一的完美预见均衡具有股价泡沫特征。关键假设在于生产技术呈现规模报酬递减（因此企业获得正利润），且工资收入与股息收入的增长率不同。我们将后一特性与劳动投入的Inada条件违反联系起来。该唯一均衡未能满足平衡增长的性质。
title: Inevitability of stock price bubbles in simple growth models
title_zh: 股票价格泡沫在简单增长模型中的必然性

abstract: This paper studies incomplete information social interaction models with exogenous network structures under rational expectations, where an agent’s outcome is affected by the expected outcomes of other agents through a network. Incomplete information models are suitable for cases where an agent’s outcome is not fully observed or precisely predictable to others. Under an asymptotic framework with many small networks, we derive efficiency bounds for the model. The derivation requires the information matrix to be non-singular. We show that the information matrix is non-singular under an identification condition based on observed network structures.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在理性预期下，具有外生网络结构的不完全信息社会互动模型，其中个体的结果通过网络受到其他个体预期结果的影响。不完全信息模型适用于个体结果未被他人完全观察或精确预测的情形。在包含许多小网络的渐近框架下，我们推导了该模型的效率界。推导过程要求信息矩阵非奇异。我们证明，在基于观测网络结构的识别条件下，信息矩阵是非奇异的。
title: Efficiency bounds for incomplete information social interaction models with network structures
title_zh: 网络结构下不完全信息社会互动模型的效率边界

abstract: We investigate the impact of information disclosure, via a statistical instrument, on consumer welfare in competitive insurance markets with limited screening. We demonstrate that, under natural constraints on information disclosure, no statistical instrument is “safe” to implement. There always exists a nonnegligible set of prior beliefs about the risk types of consumers, compatible with an observed market situation, under which additional information disclosure strictly worsens welfare.
abstract_zh: 我们研究在有限筛选的竞争性保险市场中，通过统计工具进行信息披露对消费者福利的影响。我们证明，在信息披露的自然约束条件下，没有任何统计工具是“安全”可实施的。总存在一组不可忽略的、与观察到的市场状况相容的关于消费者风险类型的先验信念，在这些信念下，额外的信息披露会严格降低福利。
title: Disclosure in Insurance Markets with Limited Screening
title_zh: 有限筛选下保险市场的信息披露

abstract: Compact development and low-carbon development in urban areas are critical pathways to tackle the problems concerning urban sprawl and climate change, which are pivotal for fostering and achieving urban sustainability. However, whether pursuing urban compactness constrains the realization of low-carbon goals remains to be elucidated. Accordingly, this study investigates the compactness-emission nexus and possible strategies for synchronizing compact urban development with carbon reduction. Using a city-level panel dataset covering 84 cities in eastern China over nine observed years in 2012–2022, the study first measures urban compactness through land use intensity, population density and land use mix; carbon emissions are measured by per unit built-up area carbon emission (UCE) and per capita carbon emissions (PCE). Then, the study employs panel regression models to analyze their relationships and the moderating role of environmental governance. Conclusions are majorly threefold. Firstly, the degree of urban compactness in eastern Chinese cities has increased over the past decade. Secondly, different dimensions of urban compactness have varying impacts on carbon emissions. Population density exhibits a significant negative effect on both UCE and PCE, while the growing land use intensity significantly elevates carbon emissions. Thirdly, environmental governance plays a significant moderating role in strengthening the impact of population density on carbon emission mitigation. With high governance intensity, the marginal effect of population density on UCE reverses from + 0.37 to –1.25, while its negative effect on PCE is further reinforced from –0.46 to –12.83. These findings offer policy-relevant insights for high-density cities in eastern China and, more broadly, for developing cities to confront the climate-urbanization challenge and sustainability transition pressures.
abstract_zh: 城市紧凑发展与低碳发展是应对城市蔓延和气候变化问题的关键路径，对于促进和实现城市可持续性至关重要。然而，追求城市紧凑度是否会制约低碳目标的实现，这一问题尚待阐明。据此，本研究探讨了紧凑度与碳排放之间的关系，以及实现紧凑城市发展与碳减排同步的可能策略。利用涵盖2012-2022年间九个观测年份、中国东部84个城市的市级面板数据集，本研究首先通过土地利用强度、人口密度和土地利用混合度来衡量城市紧凑度；碳排放则以单位建成区面积碳排放（UCE）和人均碳排放（PCE）来衡量。随后，研究采用面板回归模型分析它们之间的关系以及环境治理的调节作用。主要结论有三点。第一，过去十年间，中国东部城市的紧凑度有所提升。第二，城市紧凑度的不同维度对碳排放的影响各异。人口密度对UCE和PCE均呈现显著的负向效应，而土地利用强度的增加则显著推高了碳排放。第三，环境治理在强化人口密度对碳减排的影响方面发挥着显著的调节作用。在高治理强度下，人口密度对UCE的边际效应从+0.37逆转为-1.25，而其对PCE的负向效应则从-0.46进一步增强至-12.83。这些发现为中国东部高密度城市，乃至更广泛的发展中城市应对气候-城市化挑战及可持续转型压力提供了具有政策参考价值的见解。

title: Unpacking the compactness-emission nexus with the moderating role of environmental governance: Evidence from urban built-up areas in eastern China
title_zh: 环境治理调节下的紧凑度-排放关系解析：来自中国东部城市建成区的证据

abstract: Parameter instability has been widely documented to lead to poor predictive accuracy for economic forecasting models. Adaptive schemes for data weighting such as rolling-window estimation only involve a single tuning parameter (akin to a bandwidth) and are often used to address this issue. The importance of the shape of the weighting scheme (kernel) has received far less attention in the forecasting literature. In this paper we show that in practice there can be a large discrepancy between the theoretically optimal bias-variance tradeoff, based on the optimal bandwidth, and the actual bias-variance trade-off in practice, which depends jointly on the kernel shape as well as the (typically non-optimal) bandwidth. Simplifying this joint optimization problem by focusing only on one dimension, we show that optimizing over the kernel shape rather than the bandwidth often constitutes a better performing and more practical choice. We establish that a class of affine kernel shapes indexed by a single parameter, s, is optimal under squared forecast error loss, show that the shape parameter can be restricted to the interval [0, 2], where s = 0 corresponds to a uniform kernel (rolling-window) and s = 2 corresponds to a triangular kernel, and develop a robust three-point grid search method for choosing this shape parameter. An empirical analysis of U.S. inflation forecasting demonstrates the advantage of optimizing for the kernel shape parameter, particularly in unstable environments characterized by a time-varying bias-variance trade-off.
abstract_zh: 参数不稳定性已被广泛证实会导致经济预测模型的预测精度下降。诸如滚动窗口估计之类的自适应数据加权方案仅涉及单一调优参数（类似于带宽），常用于解决此问题。然而，在预测文献中，加权方案（核函数）形状的重要性受到的关注较少。本文表明，在实践中，基于最优带宽的理论最优偏差-方差权衡与实际中的偏差-方差权衡之间可能存在显著差异，后者同时依赖于核函数形状以及（通常非最优的）带宽。通过简化这一联合优化问题，仅聚焦于一个维度，我们证明，优化核函数形状而非带宽往往构成更优性能且更实用的选择。我们确立了一类由单一参数s索引的仿射核函数形状在平方预测误差损失下是最优的，表明形状参数可限制在区间[0, 2]内，其中s = 0对应均匀核（滚动窗口），s = 2对应三角核，并开发了一种稳健的三点网格搜索方法来选择此形状参数。对美国通胀预测的实证分析展示了优化核函数形状参数的优势，尤其是在以时变偏差-方差权衡为特征的不稳定环境中。
title: Shaping forecast models for arbitrary choice of bandwidth
title_zh: 为任意带宽选择构建预测模型

abstract: We study the retail price pass‐through of four major tax changes in petroleum products using daily pricing data from gas stations on small Greek islands. We find that (i) the pass‐through of the tax hikes is five times higher than for the tax decrease, (ii) the pass‐through of the tax hikes increases with competition, while that of the tax decrease does not, (iii) there is significant asymmetry in the speed of price adjustments, and (iv) the asymmetric price adjustment can be rationalized by either tacit collusion or consumer search behavior, as the most plausible explanations.
abstract_zh: 我们利用希腊小岛上加油站的每日定价数据，研究了石油产品四次重大税收变动的零售价格传导效应。研究发现：（i）税收上调的传导效应是税收下调的五倍；（ii）税收上调的传导效应随竞争程度增强而提高，而税收下调的传导效应则不受竞争影响；（iii）价格调整速度存在显著的不对称性；（iv）这种不对称价格调整最合理的解释是默契合谋或消费者搜寻行为。
title: Asymmetric Pass‐Through and Competition
title_zh: 非对称传导与竞争

abstract: Even after economic liberalization in the 1990s, the role of the state in Africa’s traditional tropical commodity export sectors has remained extensive. This paper argues that post-liberalization, these patterns of state regulation have often been shaped by the pressures and incentives of partisan politics, just as they were in earlier decades. We compare and contrast the changing institutional structure and patterns of state regulation in four agricultural commodity export sectors: Côte d'Ivoire-cocoa, Ghana-cocoa, Kenya-coffee, and Uganda-coffee. In spite of important differences, all four sectors are critical in providing resources, organizational structure, and policy mechanisms for building and maintaining electoral and other forms of political support for historically powerful political parties and/or power contenders. Post-1990s, each of the four cases presents an alternative pattern of alignment between export-sector organizations and partisan politics. Comparison across cases reveals the depth and variety of the ways in which domestic politics in African countries, including electoral politics, can shape state intervention in commodity chains for agro-exports, even in the neoliberal era. One implication for development studies is that domestic political and partisan dynamics are likely to continue to influence how governments use their “policy space” in supply chain governance in the future.
abstract_zh: 即便在1990年代经济自由化之后，国家在非洲传统热带农产品出口部门中的作用依然广泛。本文认为，自由化后，这些国家监管模式往往受到党派政治压力与激励的影响，正如早前几十年一样。我们比较并对比了四个农业商品出口部门中制度结构与国家监管模式的变化：科特迪瓦的可可、加纳的可可、肯尼亚的咖啡以及乌干达的咖啡。尽管存在重要差异，这四个部门在提供资源、组织结构及政策机制方面均至关重要，用以构建并维持历史上强大政党及/或权力争夺者的选举及其他形式的政治支持。1990年代后，这四个案例各自呈现了出口部门组织与党派政治之间不同的对齐模式。跨案例比较揭示了非洲国家国内政治（包括选举政治）如何以深度和多样性方式影响农产品出口商品链中的国家干预，即便在新自由主义时代亦然。对发展研究的一个启示是，国内政治与党派动态很可能继续影响未来政府如何运用其在供应链治理中的“政策空间”。
title: Partisan politics and sectoral policy in Africa’s agro-export commodity chains
title_zh: 党派政治与非洲农业出口商品链中的部门政策

abstract: Green mergers and acquisitions (M&A) represent a pivotal strategy for corporate sustainable transition. Using data from Chinese A-share listed companies (2010–2024), this study examines how executives’ environmental backgrounds shape green M&A decisions and outcomes. The results show that executives’ environmental backgrounds significantly drive companies’ green M&A activities, and the promoting effect is more significant when the executives hold greater power. Heterogeneity analysis shows that the impact of executives’ environmental backgrounds on green M&A varies contingent on firm characteristics and financing constraints. The promoting effect is more pronounced for state-owned enterprises and enterprises with a high proportion of institutional ownership, yet no significant difference is observed between heavily polluting and non-heavily polluting firms. However, the impact is statistically insignificant for enterprises facing tight external financing constraints, regardless of whether the financing channel is debt financing or equity financing. Further analysis indicates that green M&A generates short-term market reactions, boosting cumulative abnormal returns. Furthermore, this study finds that the executives’ environmental backgrounds can significantly improve enterprises’ environmental and economic performance following green M&A activities. Overall, these findings illuminate the internal governance mechanisms driving corporate green transformation.
abstract_zh: 绿色并购是企业可持续转型的关键战略。基于2010-2024年中国A股上市公司数据，本文考察高管环保背景如何影响绿色并购决策与成效。研究发现：高管环保背景显著推动企业绿色并购活动，且当高管权力较大时，这种促进作用更为显著。异质性分析表明，高管环保背景对绿色并购的影响因企业特征与融资约束而异：国有企业及机构持股比例较高企业的促进作用更显著，但重污染与非重污染企业间未呈现显著差异；然而，当企业面临较强外部融资约束时（无论融资渠道为债务融资还是股权融资），该影响在统计上不显著。进一步分析显示，绿色并购能产生短期市场反应，提升累计异常收益率。此外，本文发现高管环保背景可显著改善企业绿色并购后的环境绩效与经济绩效。总体而言，这些发现揭示了驱动企业绿色转型的内部治理机制。

title: Leading green paths: the impact of executives’ environmental backgrounds on corporate green mergers and acquisitions
title_zh: 引领绿色路径：高管环境背景对企业绿色并购的影响

abstract: Sovereign debt yields have undergone a historic decline over the last half century. Standard explanations, including aging populations and increases in asset demand from abroad, encounter difficulties when confronted with the full range of evidence. We propose an explanation based on a decline in inflation and default risk. We show that a model with sovereign default captures the decline in interest rates, the stability of equity valuation ratios, and the reduction in investment and output growth. Calibrations of the model post-COVID suggest that sovereign default risk may have returned.
abstract_zh: 过去半个世纪，主权债务收益率经历了历史性下降。标准解释（包括人口老龄化及国外资产需求增加）在面临全面证据时遭遇困难。我们提出基于通胀与违约风险下降的解释。研究表明，包含主权违约的模型能够捕捉利率下降、股权估值比率稳定以及投资与产出增长放缓的特征。新冠疫情后的模型校准表明，主权违约风险可能已经重现。
title: Sovereign Default and the Decline in Interest Rates*
title_zh: 主权违约与利率下降

abstract: Can modes of collective action, including protests, demonstrations, and marches influence court decisions, even without affecting the law or formal institutions? Here, I assess the influence of protests on the results of removal proceedings in U.S. immigration courts. Using a difference-in-differences design and administrative immigration court data, I compare removal proceedings outcomes around the time of the 2006 immigration reform protests. I find some evidence of a small and temporary influence on removal decisions. The probability of removals appears to decrease by approximately 2 percentage points for up to 3 weeks following the protests’ onset. There is little evidence that the overall effect of mobilization has medium or long term influence on outcomes. The effect varies across case, location and judge characteristics.
abstract_zh: 集体行动模式，包括抗议、示威和游行，能否在不影响法律或正式制度的情况下影响法院判决？在此，我评估了抗议对美国移民法院遣返程序结果的影响。采用双重差分设计并利用行政移民法院数据，我比较了2006年移民改革抗议前后遣返程序的结果。我发现有证据表明，抗议对遣返决定产生了微小且暂时的影响。在抗议开始后的三周内，遣返概率似乎下降了约2个百分点。几乎没有证据显示动员的总体效应在中期或长期内对结果有影响。这种效应因案件、地点和法官特征的不同而有所差异。
title: Do social movements influence decision makers? Evidence from U.S. immigration courts
title_zh: 社会运动是否影响决策者？来自美国移民法庭的证据

abstract: Based on knowledge combination theory, we explore the effect of the U.S. Entity List on firm breakthrough innovation, using a research sample of Chinese A-share listed firms from 2013 to 2022. Our findings reveal that the U.S. Entity List significantly inhibits these firms' breakthrough innovation. The U.S. Entity List lowers knowledge breadth while enhancing knowledge depth. However, as the impact of knowledge breadth on breakthrough innovation outweighs that of knowledge depth, the U.S. Entity List ultimately inhibits firm breakthrough innovation. Government innovation subsidies and supply chain integration capabilities of firms mitigate the negative effect of the U.S. Entity List on breakthrough innovation. Additionally, we find that the negative effect of the U.S. Entity List on breakthrough innovation is stronger in technology-intensive, regulated, and competitive industries.
abstract_zh: 基于知识组合理论，本文以2013至2022年中国A股上市公司为研究样本，探讨了美国实体清单对企业突破性创新的影响。研究发现，美国实体清单显著抑制了这些企业的突破性创新。该清单降低了知识广度，同时提升了知识深度。然而，由于知识广度对突破性创新的影响大于知识深度，美国实体清单最终抑制了企业的突破性创新。政府创新补贴及企业的供应链整合能力缓解了美国实体清单对突破性创新的负面效应。此外，本文还发现，在技术密集型、受监管及竞争激烈的行业中，美国实体清单对突破性创新的负面效应更为显著。

title: How the U.S. entity list affects firm breakthrough innovation: A perspective on knowledge depth and breadth
title_zh: 美国实体清单如何影响企业突破性创新：基于知识深度与广度的视角

abstract: Progressive social ranking rules assign greater weight to shifts in voters' preferences occurring lower in their ranking, potentially enhancing egalitarianism between individuals with more and with less favored alternatives, compared to non-progressive rules. Weakly robust ranking rules are not overly sensitive to the smallest admissible change in an individual’s preferences. We axiomatically characterize four classes of progressive and weakly robust ranking rules: the comprehensive class, the negative quadratic (NQ) class, the constant absolute inequality aversion (CAIA) class and, in a continuous setting, the constant relative inequality aversion (CRIA) class. We also identify the subclass satisfying a stronger robustness requirement that limits excessive sensitivity to bottom-rank changes. The rules within the CAIA class are parameterized by a variable β ∈ ( 1 , ∞ ) , representing progressivity levels. The Borda and inverse plurality rules are obtained as special cases at the lower and upper bounds of β . Selecting the appropriate rule within this class requires deciding upon the desired level of progressivity and we illustrate how one can opt for a context-dependent choice of β by employing the median voter theorem. Finally, we provide a complete taxonomy of our four classes and the Borda rule, which leads to the axiomatization of the negative squared Borda rule, demonstrating its unique position within the intersection of the NQ and CRIA classes.
abstract_zh: 渐进式社会排序规则赋予选民偏好中排名较低位置的变化以更大的权重，与非渐进式规则相比，这可能在拥有更受青睐和较少受青睐备选方案的个体之间增强平等主义。弱稳健排序规则对个体偏好中最小的可允许变化不过度敏感。我们公理化地刻画了四类渐进且弱稳健的排序规则：综合类、负二次（NQ）类、常数绝对不平等厌恶（CAIA）类，以及在连续设定下的常数相对不平等厌恶（CRIA）类。我们还识别出一个满足更强稳健性要求的子类，该要求限制了对底部排名变化的过度敏感性。CAIA类中的规则由参数β∈(1,∞)参数化，代表渐进性水平。博尔达规则和逆多数规则分别在β的下界和上界处作为特例获得。在此类中选择合适的规则需要决定所需的渐进性水平，我们通过运用中位选民定理说明如何根据情境选择β。最后，我们提供了我们四类规则与博尔达规则的完整分类体系，这引出了负平方博尔达规则的公理化，展示了其在NQ和CRIA类交集内的独特地位。
title: Progressive and Robust Scoring Rules: Axiomatic Taxonomy
title_zh: 渐进且稳健的评分规则：公理分类

abstract: Firms navigating the transition towards sustainable manufacturing face a critical strategic question: Can voluntary environmental regulation (VER) reconcile the tension between environmental compliance and market performance? Using Chinese A-share data from 2008 to 2024, this study treats the Green Factory Certification (GFC) Program as a quasi-natural experiment to examine the impact of VER on corporate market value. The results show that GFC significantly increases corporate market value. Mechanism analysis indicates that the policy mainly boosts market value through two paths: promoting green innovation and attracting green investors. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that policy benefits are more pronounced in labour-intensive, non-state-owned, non-heavy-polluting enterprises and in regions characterized by stringent environmental regulation and higher levels of economic development.
abstract_zh: 在向可持续制造转型的过程中，企业面临一个关键的战略问题：自愿性环境规制能否调和环境合规与市场绩效之间的张力？本研究利用2008至2024年中国A股数据，将绿色工厂认证计划视为准自然实验，考察自愿性环境规制对企业市场价值的影响。结果表明，绿色工厂认证显著提升了企业市场价值。机制分析显示，该政策主要通过两条路径提升市场价值：促进绿色创新和吸引绿色投资者。异质性分析表明，政策收益在劳动密集型、非国有、非重污染企业以及环境规制严格、经济发展水平较高的地区更为显著。
china_relevance_reason: 研究使用中国A股数据，以中国绿色工厂认证为政策实验，核心对象是中国企业。
title: From policy to valuation: how voluntary environmental regulation drives corporate value
title_zh: 从政策到估值：自愿性环境规制如何驱动企业价值

abstract: Online sales have been deepening the integration of digital and real economies and driving enterprise development in recent years, but their impact on the expansion of enterprises’ innovation boundaries remains underexplored. Based on constructing a heterogeneous innovation theory model, this paper conducts empirical tests using two-way fixed‑effects models, combined with unbalanced panel data of A-share listed enterprises from 2015 to 2024. The results showed that online sales significantly expand enterprises’ innovation boundaries and help increase the number of patents. From mechanism perspectives, online sales encourage companies’ substantive technological innovation, resulting in technological breakthroughs through broadening market information channels, promoting knowledge and technology spillovers and altering enterprises’ innovation strategies. Heterogeneity analyses revealed that the effect of online sales is more pronounced for enterprises with a higher degree of digital transformation, larger scale and low market share. This study provides new empirical evidence for exploring how online sales can be leveraged to empower enterprise innovation and the innovation incentives of digital-real integration
abstract_zh: 近年来，线上销售持续深化数字经济与实体经济的融合，并驱动企业发展，但其对企业创新边界拓展的影响尚未得到充分探究。本文在构建异质性创新理论模型的基础上，采用双向固定效应模型，结合2015—2024年A股上市企业非平衡面板数据进行实证检验。结果表明，线上销售显著拓展了企业的创新边界，并有助于增加专利数量。从机制视角来看，线上销售通过拓宽市场信息渠道、促进知识和技术溢出以及改变企业创新策略，鼓励企业开展实质性技术创新，从而实现技术突破。异质性分析显示，对于数字化转型程度较高、规模较大且市场份额较低的企业，线上销售的影响更为显著。本研究为探索如何利用线上销售赋能企业创新以及数字融合的创新激励提供了新的经验证据。
title: Online sales and the expansion of enterprises’ innovation boundaries: on the innovation incentive of digital-real integration
title_zh: 线上销售与企业创新边界扩张：数字实体融合的创新激励研究

abstract: Focus The extent to which exchange rate changes affect consumer prices typically varies a lot between countries and time periods. While there is a large empirical literature on measuring exchange rate pass-through, much less is known about which specific factors drive the magnitude of exchange rate pass-through and the relative contribution of these different factors.
abstract_zh: 焦点 汇率变动对消费者价格的影响程度在不同国家和时期通常存在显著差异。尽管已有大量关于汇率传递效应的实证研究文献，但关于哪些具体因素驱动汇率传递效应的大小以及这些不同因素的相对贡献，目前仍知之甚少。
title: What drives exchange rate pass-throughs? Evidence from a non-parametric method
title_zh: 什么驱动了汇率传递效应？来自非参数方法的证据

abstract: Using linked survey and administrative wage records, we measure workers’ financial monitoring through the accuracy of their self-reported earnings. An unsupervised latent-class model distinguishes transitory reporting errors from rounding behavior and persistent reporting biases, allowing us to interpret lower reporting uncertainty as more precise knowledge of one’s wages. Among low-wage workers, reporting precision exhibits a pronounced pay-cycle pattern: it increases by approximately 12 percent in the days leading up to payday and declines immediately afterward. No comparable pattern emerges among higher-wage workers. These findings suggest that predictable liquidity constraints lead low-wage workers to monitor their personal finances more closely as payday approaches.
abstract_zh: 利用关联的调查数据与行政工资记录，我们通过工人自报收入的准确性来衡量其财务监控程度。采用无监督潜类别模型，将暂时性报告误差与四舍五入行为及持续性报告偏差区分开来，从而将较低的报告不确定性解释为对自身工资更精确的认知。在低收入工人群体中，报告精确性呈现出显著的薪酬周期模式：发薪日前数天精确性提升约12%，发薪日后立即下降。而高收入工人中未发现类似模式。这些发现表明，可预测的流动性约束导致低收入工人在发薪日临近时更密切地监控个人财务状况。
title: Payday and the Monthly Attention Cycle of Low-Wage Workers
title_zh: 发薪日与低薪工人的月度注意力周期

abstract: This study investigates how monetary policy uncertainty shapes corporate investment efficiency based on an unbalanced panel of 5,090 Chinese A-share listed firms over the period 2011–2024. The findings indicate that heightened monetary policy uncertainty leads to a significant deterioration in investment efficiency. This relationship remains stable after adopting alternative measures, introducing lagged terms, removing observations from the COVID-19 period, and applying instrumental-variable estimation. Mechanism analysis shows that tighter financing constraints and lower R&D expenditure constitute two important channels underlying this effect. The negative influence is particularly evident among capital-intensive and technology-intensive firms, state-owned enterprises, and firms characterized by CEO duality. Moreover, an upgraded human capital structure enhances firms’ capacity to absorb policy-related shocks and weakens the adverse effect of monetary policy uncertainty. These findings advance the understanding of firm-level responses to macroeconomic policy uncertainty and offer practical insights into policy communication, innovation financing, human capital allocation, and corporate investment management.
abstract_zh: 本研究基于2011–2024年间5090家中国A股上市公司的非平衡面板数据，考察货币政策不确定性如何影响企业投资效率。研究发现，货币政策不确定性上升会显著降低企业投资效率。在采用替代性指标、引入滞后项、剔除新冠疫情时期观测值以及运用工具变量估计后，该结论依然稳健。机制分析表明，融资约束趋紧与研发支出下降是这一效应的两个重要传导渠道。这种负面影响在资本密集型和技术密集型企业、国有企业以及董事长兼任总经理的企业中尤为显著。此外，人力资本结构升级能够增强企业吸收政策冲击的能力，从而削弱货币政策不确定性的不利影响。这些发现深化了对企业应对宏观经济政策不确定性的理解，并为政策沟通、创新融资、人力资本配置及企业投资管理提供了实践启示。关键词：货币政策不确定性；投资效率；融资约束；研发投资；人力资本结构 JEL分类号：M21 G38 M10 J24

title: Research on the impact mechanism of monetary policy shocks and the synergy of human capital structure on corporate investment
title_zh: 货币政策冲击与人力资本结构协同对企业投资的影响机制研究

abstract: We empirically investigate the utilization rates of the two existing regional trade agreements (RTAs) in Japan's monthly imports from Vietnam from January 2017 to December 2021. In particular, we explore the changes in these rates before and after the commencement of the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans‐Pacific Partnership (CPTPP), focusing on the products for which CPTPP offered the lowest tariffs. We did not find significant changes in the utilization rates of either existing RTAs or the most‐favoured nation (MFN) regime before CPTPP's entry in January 2019. However, exporters familiar with the use of preferences (i.e., existing RTA users) appear to have switched to CPTPP first, followed by unfamiliar users (MFN users) who switched to it gradually. Consequently, the introduction of a new RTA was associated with a sustained expansion of trade, unlike the gradual tariff reduction in a single RTA observed in the previous study.
abstract_zh: 本文实证研究了2017年1月至2021年12月期间，日本从越南月度进口中两项现有区域贸易协定（RTAs）的利用率。我们特别关注《全面与进步跨太平洋伙伴关系协定》（CPTPP）生效前后这些利用率的变化，重点分析CPTPP提供最低关税的产品。研究发现，在2019年1月CPTPP生效前，现有RTAs或最惠国待遇（MFN）机制的利用率并未出现显著变化。然而，熟悉优惠使用的出口商（即现有RTA用户）似乎率先转向CPTPP，随后不熟悉优惠使用的用户（MFN用户）逐步跟进。因此，新RTAs的引入与贸易的持续扩张相关联，这与先前研究中单一RTA逐步降税所观察到的模式有所不同。
title: Switching Between Existing and New Trade Agreements: Evidence From Japan's Imports From Vietnam
title_zh: 现有贸易协定与新贸易协定之间的切换：来自日本从越南进口的证据

abstract: Following Russia’s 2022 invasion of Ukraine, official trade sanctions were accompanied by private sanctions: voluntary decisions by firms to reduce or cease supplying the Russian market. This paper examines whether private sanctions curtailed trade beyond official restrictions. We use trademark information to connect transaction-level data on Russian imports with trademark owners’ public statements on their Russian operations. Imports linked to firms announcing private sanctions declined significantly relative to those associated with firms making no such commitments, indicating substantial compliance with withdrawal pledges. These declines also affected goods not covered by official sanctions, broadening the effective scope of trade restrictions, although third-country intermediation weakened the effects. The results are robust to instrumental-variable strategy exploiting variation in investor scrutiny, proxied by public listing status, and imply effects equivalent to ad valorem tariffs of 9–84 percent under plausible trade elasticities. These findings show that public pressure can have meaningful geopolitical consequences.
abstract_zh: 2022年俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后，官方贸易制裁与私人制裁同步实施：企业自愿决定减少或停止向俄罗斯市场供货。本文旨在检验私人制裁是否在官方限制之外进一步抑制了贸易。我们利用商标信息，将俄罗斯进口的交易层面数据与商标所有者关于其在俄业务的公开声明进行匹配。与未作出此类承诺的企业相关的进口相比，宣布实施私人制裁的企业所关联的进口显著下降，这表明撤资承诺得到了实质性遵守。这些下降还波及了官方制裁未覆盖的商品，从而扩大了贸易限制的实际范围，尽管第三国中介效应削弱了其影响。基于投资者关注度差异（以公开上市状态为代理变量）的工具变量策略验证了结果的稳健性，并在合理贸易弹性假设下，其影响相当于9%至84%的从价关税。这些发现表明，公众压力可产生重要的地缘政治后果。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后的制裁，数据、制度背景均不涉及中国。
title: Not wearing Prada: Do private sanctions reinforce official sanctions?
title_zh: 不穿普拉达：私人制裁是否强化了官方制裁？

abstract: We develop a nonlinear model in which trend inflation and inflation tail risks emerge endogenously in equilibrium from the interaction between the primary deficit and the risk of supply disruptions. The key friction is limited fiscal responsibility: the government stabilizes debt in the long run but, unwilling to let debt accumulate too quickly, pressures the central bank to restrain interest-rate increases rather than adjust its own budget. The fiscal limit binds asymmetrically across shocks, with inflationary supply shocks especially likely to push monetary policy against the constraint. As supply-shock volatility rises and fiscal space narrows, the constraint binds more often. Anticipating this, agents raise their inflation expectations, causing trend inflation and upside inflation tail risks to rise even before the constraint binds. Movements in supply-shock volatility and fiscal space together account for much of the ratcheting up and down of U.S. trend inflation between 1965 and 1990. Interpreted through the model, the post-pandemic rise in long-run inflation expectations reflects a higher probability of fiscally constrained monetary policy.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个非线性模型，其中趋势通胀与通胀尾部风险通过基本赤字与供给中断风险的相互作用在均衡中内生形成。核心摩擦在于有限财政责任：政府虽在长期内稳定债务，但因不愿让债务过快累积，转而施压央行限制利率上调而非调整自身预算。财政约束对不同冲击呈现非对称约束效应——通胀性供给冲击尤其容易迫使货币政策触碰该约束。随着供给冲击波动率上升与财政空间收窄，约束触发频率显著增加。预期到这一机制，经济主体提前上调通胀预期，导致趋势通胀与上行通胀尾部风险在约束实际生效前已然攀升。1965年至1990年间，供给冲击波动率与财政空间的协同变动，解释了美国趋势通胀大部分阶梯式升降现象。通过模型解读，后疫情时期长期通胀预期的上升，反映了财政约束型货币政策发生概率的提高。
title: The Perils of Narrowing Fiscal Spaces
title_zh: 财政空间收窄的风险

abstract: Exploiting variation in debt‐to‐income ratios across US counties at the onset of the Great Recession, we investigate the impact of debt exposure on suicide. We find that more indebted counties saw a significant rise in suicide rates, with effects double for men and triple among adults ages 40–64. These patterns align with financial responsibilities: men are primary borrowers on mortgages, and middle‐aged adults hold the most secured debt. The impact of debt on suicide behavior, with annual costs of several billion dollars, underscores the welfare implications of inflexible household debt instruments.
abstract_zh: 利用大衰退初期美国各县债务收入比的变化，我们研究了债务暴露对自杀行为的影响。研究发现，债务负担更重的县自杀率显著上升，其中男性自杀率增幅为女性两倍，40-64岁成年人自杀率增幅为其他年龄段三倍。这些模式与财务责任分布高度吻合：男性是抵押贷款的主要借款人，而中年人持有最多担保债务。债务对自杀行为的影响——每年造成数十亿美元的社会成本——凸显了缺乏灵活性的家庭债务工具对福利的深远影响。
title: Financial suicide: Debt and death across US counties during the Great Recession
title_zh: 金融自杀：大衰退期间美国各县的债务与死亡

abstract: In response to rising consumer demand for food safety, many countries have implemented food traceability systems (FTS) to enhance transparency and accountability along agricultural supply chains. While existing research has largely focused on demand side aspects, evidence on supply side responses remains limited. This study addresses this gap by examining the effects of FTS adoption on farm production practices, specifically the probability of using chemical fertilizers, pesticides, and groundwater, as well as farm revenue and marketing channel selection. We use microdata from Taiwan’s 2020 agriculture census, which provides both plot-level and farm household-level information covering all registered crop farms. Motivated by a farm profit maximization model, we employ an instrumental variable (IV) approach to identify the local average treatment effect of FTS adoption. At the plot level, FTS adoption reduces the probability of using chemical fertilizer, pesticide, and groundwater by 8.2, 15.4, and 40 percentage points, respectively. At the household level, FTS adoption increases farm revenues and expands sales through direct-to-consumer and distributor channels. These findings suggest that while FTS is primarily designed to ensure food safety and market transparency, its adoption may generate unintended environmental co-benefits through reducing the likelihood of using environmentally sensitive inputs in farm production.
abstract_zh: 为应对消费者日益增长的食品安全需求，许多国家实施了食品可追溯系统（FTS），以提升农业供应链的透明度与问责性。尽管现有研究多聚焦于需求侧，供给侧响应的证据仍显不足。本研究通过考察FTS采用对农场生产实践的影响，填补了这一空白，具体涉及化肥、农药及地下水使用的概率，以及农场收入和营销渠道选择。我们利用台湾2020年农业普查的微观数据，该数据涵盖所有注册作物农场的地块层面和农户层面信息。基于农场利润最大化模型，我们采用工具变量（IV）方法识别FTS采用的局部平均处理效应。在地块层面，FTS采用使化肥、农药和地下水使用的概率分别降低8.2、15.4和40个百分点。在农户层面，FTS采用增加了农场收入，并扩大了通过直接面向消费者和分销商渠道的销售。这些发现表明，尽管FTS主要旨在确保食品安全和市场透明度，其采用可能通过降低农场生产中使用环境敏感投入品的可能性，产生非预期的环境协同效益。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为台湾2020年农业普查数据，台湾属于中国地区，且制度背景为台湾的食品追溯体系，故直接相关。
title: Food traceability systems and the probability of using chemical fertilizers and pesticides − empirical evidence using plot and farm household data from agriculture census
title_zh: 食品追溯体系与化肥农药使用概率——基于农业普查地块与农户数据的实证证据

abstract: Age at first birth has increased over time, which is likely to create many benefits in the labour market. Applying a number of alternative estimation approaches to administrative data from Austria, we estimate small to moderate effects of delaying motherhood on earnings, employment, and attachment to pre-birth firms in the medium run. However, even the largest of these effects are small relative to the average age effects, implying that delay leads to only small changes in child penalties. Much of the career return to later first birth comes from delaying the child penalty rather than changing how careers respond to children.
abstract_zh: 初育年龄随时间推移而上升，这很可能在劳动力市场中带来诸多益处。通过运用多种替代性估计方法对奥地利行政数据进行分析，我们发现在中期内，推迟生育对女性收入、就业状况及与产前企业的依附关系仅产生较小至中等程度的影响。然而，即便这些影响中最为显著的效应，相较于平均年龄效应而言仍显微弱，这意味着推迟生育仅能小幅改变育儿惩罚。推迟初育带来的职业回报，主要源于育儿惩罚的延迟而非职业发展对育儿行为反应的改变。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Motherhood timing and the child penalty
title_zh: 母亲生育时机与子女惩罚

abstract: Central banks and financial surveillance authorities need to cope with the potential realization of financial stability risks, adopting preventive measures or using liquidity once crises materialize. Transition risk — the stability risk associated with decarbonization — is a case in point. Such risk not only comes from policy changes, but also from preference shocks. Hence, this paper develops an environmental DSGE model with financial frictions and examines responses to shocks, including a novel angle on preference shocks. We show that these market-driven transition shocks generate larger macro financial instability than carbon pricing for a given change in emissions, while delaying environmental gains. We then compare policy responses according to their timing. Ex-ante macroprudential policies that reduce banks’ exposure to transition risk dampen financial amplification, whereas ex-post interventions, such as quantitative easing, provide only partial stabilization once losses have materialized. Overall, our results indicate that market-led adjustments to transition risk are more destabilizing than carbon pricing, whereas preventive financial measures limit macro-financial instability more effectively than ex-post interventions under the policy comparisons considered, supporting the case for early action.
abstract_zh: 中央银行和金融监管当局需要应对金融稳定风险可能实现的情况，在危机发生时采取预防性措施或动用流动性。转型风险——与脱碳相关的稳定性风险——就是一个典型例子。此类风险不仅源于政策变化，还来自偏好冲击。为此，本文构建了一个包含金融摩擦的环境动态随机一般均衡模型，并从偏好冲击这一新颖视角考察了各冲击的响应。研究表明，在给定排放变化条件下，这些市场驱动的转型冲击比碳定价引发更大的宏观金融不稳定，同时延迟环境效益的实现。随后，我们根据政策实施时机比较了不同政策应对措施。事前宏观审慎政策通过降低银行对转型风险的敞口来抑制金融放大效应，而事后干预措施（如量化宽松）在损失发生后仅能提供部分稳定效果。总体而言，我们的结果表明，市场主导的转型风险调整比碳定价更具不稳定性，而在所考虑的政策比较中，预防性金融措施比事后干预更能有效限制宏观金融不稳定，这为尽早采取行动提供了支持依据。
title: Preference Shocks and Policy Responses to Transition Risk
title_zh: 偏好冲击与转型风险的政策应对

abstract: European banking remains fragmented, leaving billions of euros inefficiently allocated. Reforms to establish a European deposit insurance system have been proposed to allow cross-border banking groups to operate more freely. This column argues that a common deposit insurance system fundamentally changes the link between risk-sharing and risk-taking. In addition to greater integration, it can encourage more risk-taking, with unclear effects on overall welfare. Therefore, greater freedom to move capital and liquidity across borders should be accompanied by sufficiently strict supervision to address the risk-taking incentives created by such reforms.
abstract_zh: 欧洲银行业仍处于碎片化状态，导致数十亿欧元资金配置效率低下。为建立欧洲存款保险体系而提出的改革方案，旨在允许跨境银行集团更自由地运营。本专栏认为，共同存款保险体系从根本上改变了风险分担与风险承担之间的关联。除了促进一体化外，它还可能鼓励更多风险承担行为，但对整体福利的影响尚不明确。因此，在赋予资本和流动性跨境流动更大自由度的同时，必须辅以足够严格的监管，以应对此类改革所催生的风险承担激励。
authors: Gyöngyi Lóránth, Anatoli Segura, Jing Zeng

title: Achieving a European Banking Union without increasing risks

abstract: As digital, environmental, and demographic transformations reshape labour markets, skills influence who benefits from these changes and who falls behind. This column presents the findings of an International Labour Organization report that shows that socio-emotional and cognitive skills are in high demand and that employers seek rounded skills profiles. However, most countries still lack ambitious lifelong learning systems. The inclusiveness, quality, and adaptability of such systems will influence how economies and societies navigate structural transformation.
abstract_zh: 随着数字化、环境与人口结构的转型重塑劳动力市场，技能决定了谁能从这些变革中受益、谁又将落后。本专栏介绍了国际劳工组织一份报告的研究发现：社会情感技能与认知技能需求旺盛，雇主更青睐综合型技能人才。然而，多数国家仍缺乏具有前瞻性的终身学习体系。这类体系的包容性、质量与适应性，将深刻影响各经济体与社会如何应对结构性转型。
authors: Isaure Delaporte, Verónica Escudero, Hannah Liepmann
title: Lifelong learning is becoming increasingly important in response to labour market transformations
title_zh: 终身学习在应对劳动力市场转型中的重要性日益凸显

abstract: Asia-Pacific has undergone a profound transformation over the past few decades, increasing its share in global trade and GDP. This paper assesses to what extent Asia-Pacific’s role in global finance has expanded commensurately and whether it has become more integrated by systematically analyzing crossborder financial data. We combine descriptive analyses of past trends in financial positions with network analysis to understand how inter- and intra- regional financial linkages have evolved for economies in the region. We find that Asia-Pacific’s role in global finance still significantly lags its role in global trade and that there is considerable heterogeneity within the region. Advanced economies in the region are well integrated into global financial markets, whereas most emerging markets exhibit more limited integration. Financial integration within the region is also low but diverges significantly by instrument. Intra-regional financial integration is advancing in foreign direct investment (FDI) and cross-border banking (the latter from low levels), but has remained limited in foreign portfolio investment (FPI). Gravity model analysis indicates a significant association between trade and FDI, but not between trade and FPI. We conclude the paper with policy recommendations to promote resilient financial integration in Asia-Pacific.
abstract_zh: 过去数十年间，亚太地区经历了深刻变革，其在全球贸易与GDP中的份额持续攀升。本文通过系统分析跨境金融数据，评估亚太地区在全球金融体系中的角色是否同步扩大，以及区域金融一体化程度是否有所提升。我们结合金融头寸历史趋势的描述性分析与网络分析方法，探究区域内及区域间金融关联的演变路径。研究发现：亚太地区在全球金融体系中的地位仍显著滞后于其在全球贸易中的角色，且区域内部存在显著异质性。区域内发达经济体已深度融入全球金融市场，而多数新兴市场的金融一体化程度相对有限。区域内部金融一体化水平整体偏低，但不同金融工具呈现显著分化——外商直接投资与跨境银行业务（后者虽基数较低）的区域内一体化程度有所提升，而证券投资组合的区域内一体化仍显不足。引力模型分析表明，贸易与外商直接投资之间存在显著关联，但贸易与证券投资组合之间未呈现类似关系。本文最后提出促进亚太地区韧性金融一体化的政策建议。
authors: Cristian Alonso & Tristan Hennig & Henry Hoyle & Haibo Li & Monica Petrescu & Ying Xu & Yizhi Xu

abstract: We examine market entry and post-entry debt dynamics in Frontier Economies by grouping countries based on durability of market access using a two-step framework combining first Eurobond issuance with the reliance on private external creditors, validated through an unsupervised K-mean clustering. A discrete-time event LOGIT model finds that favorable global liquidity conditions and investor appetite open issuance windows for countries, but domestic pull factors—income, institutions, growth, and reserve buffers—ultimately determine success of market entry. Post-entry, Frontier Economies shift rapidly toward market borrowing, with looser fiscal stance as new financing source is unlocked. Along increased exposure to rollover and global financial cycle risks, debt decomposition exercise shows a worsening interest–growth differential and rising debt, driven mainly by primary deficits and higher interest burdens. Results underscore the need for credible medium-term fiscal frameworks, stronger debt management, and reserve buffers to manage the transition to market financing.
abstract_zh: 我们通过两步法框架，将国家按市场准入的持久性进行分组，结合首次欧元债券发行与对私人外部债权人的依赖程度，并借助无监督K均值聚类进行验证，从而考察前沿经济体的市场进入及进入后的债务动态。离散时间事件LOGIT模型发现，有利的全球流动性条件和投资者偏好为各国打开了发行窗口，但国内拉动因素——收入水平、制度质量、经济增长和储备缓冲——最终决定了市场进入的成功与否。进入市场后，前沿经济体迅速转向市场借贷，随着新融资来源的解锁，财政政策趋于宽松。在面临展期风险和全球金融周期风险加剧的同时，债务分解分析显示，利息-增长差恶化且债务上升，主要源于基本赤字和更高的利息负担。研究结果强调了建立可信的中期财政框架、加强债务管理以及储备缓冲的必要性，以应对向市场融资的转型。
title: Beyond the First Bond: Market Access and Debt Dynamics in Frontier Economies
title_zh: 超越首次债券：前沿经济体的市场准入与债务动态

abstract: This paper uses a structural model calibrated to an aid-dependent economy to analytically explore the macroeconomic and distributional effects of a permanent aid cut under three alternative policy responses: non-concessional borrowing, domestic revenue mobilization, and uncompensated spending cuts. We find that a borrowing-only response leads to unsustainable debt and highly regressive outcomes. An uncompensated cut results in economic stagnation, higher poverty, and adverse inequality. Within the model, a strategy combining moderate borrowing with ambitious domestic revenue mobilization, while painful in the medium term, produces the most favorable path to fiscal sustainability and moderates the rise in poverty and inequality. These findings are analytical and model-based; they illustrate the trade-offs inherent in fiscal adjustment under aid dependence rather than prescribing specific policy actions.
abstract_zh: 本文通过构建一个校准至援助依赖型经济的结构模型，从分析层面探讨了在三种替代性政策应对方案下——即非优惠借款、国内收入动员及无补偿性支出削减——永久性援助削减对宏观经济与分配效应的影响。研究发现：仅依赖借款的应对方案将导致不可持续的债务负担及高度倒退性结果；无补偿性支出削减则引发经济停滞、贫困加剧及不平等恶化。在该模型框架下，将适度借款与积极的国内收入动员相结合的策略，尽管中期内会带来阵痛，却能最有效地实现财政可持续性路径，并缓解贫困与不平等程度的上升。上述结论基于模型分析，旨在阐明援助依赖型经济在财政调整中固有的权衡取舍，而非提供具体政策建议。
title: Closing the Gap: A LIC’s Policy Options Under an Aid Shock
title_zh: 缩小差距：援助冲击下低收入国家的政策选择

abstract: This paper explores how demographic shifts, particularly population aging, are reshaping banking in Asia-Pacific’s bank-dominated financial systems. Using household surveys as well as bank-level and country-level panel data, we show that aging populations are associated, with shifts in bank portfolios away from traditional loans (with lower loan-to-deposit and loan-to-asset ratios), driven by changes in households’ financial behavior. These changes affect banks’ funding structures, profitability, and risk profiles, with implications for financial stability. We also provide new evidence on cross-border dynamics, showing that demographic divergence spurs asset reallocation toward younger economies. Our findings highlight evolving risks and supervisory challenges as demographic transitions unfold unevenly across economies.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了人口结构变化，特别是人口老龄化，如何重塑亚太地区以银行为主导的金融体系。利用家庭调查数据以及银行层面和国家层面的面板数据，我们表明，人口老龄化与银行资产组合从传统贷款（表现为较低的贷存比和贷资比）的转移相关，这种转移由家庭金融行为的变化驱动。这些变化影响了银行的融资结构、盈利能力和风险状况，并对金融稳定产生影响。我们还提供了关于跨境动态的新证据，表明人口结构差异促使资产重新配置向更年轻的经济体转移。我们的研究结果突显了随着人口转型在各经济体间不均衡推进，不断演化的风险与监管挑战。
authors: Haibo Li & Estelle X Liu & Yinqiu Lu & Anne Oeking

abstract: We study how U.S. tariff hikes in 2025 have transmitted to import prices. Consistent with recent evidence, we find that duty-exclusive import prices at the variety (country-product) level do not adjust to tariffs, implying full pass-through to duty-inclusive prices at the border. At the product level, however, duty-exclusive aggregate import prices decline significantly with tariff increases. We show that this product-level decline is driven by within-product reallocation toward lower-priced sources—stronger in products facing larger tariff hikes—and operates primarily through the entry of lower-priced varieties and the exit of higher-priced ones. Estimates of variety appeal indicate that part of this reallocation reflects shifts toward lower-quality varieties, a channel that is also present in the 2018–19 U.S.–China tariff episode. These reallocation effects carry implications for consumer welfare and productivity through the quality of imported goods and inputs.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了2025年美国关税上调如何传导至进口价格。与近期证据一致，我们发现品种（国家-产品）层面的不含税进口价格并未随关税调整，这意味着关税完全传导至边境含税价格。然而在产品层面，不含税的总进口价格却随关税上升而显著下降。研究表明，这种产品层面的价格下降源于同一产品内部向低价来源的重新配置——在面临更大关税上调的产品中更为显著——主要通过低价品种的进入和高价品种的退出实现。品种吸引力估算表明，这种重新配置部分反映了向低质量品种的转移，这一渠道在2018-19年中美关税事件中同样存在。这些重新配置效应通过进口商品和投入品的质量渠道对消费者福利与生产率产生影响。
authors: Mr. JaeBin Ahn & Lorenzo Rotunno & Michele Ruta

title: Tariff Pass-Through and Import Reallocation
title_zh: 关税传导与进口再配置

abstract: Fuel and food constitute significant portions of consumer baskets, yet their prices are highly volatile. The renewed energy price shock in March 2026, driven by geopolitical disruptions and supply constraints, has highlighted the macroeconomic and distributional importance of how international price shocks transmit to domestic markets. Spikes in these prices can have major social, political, and economic implications. The conventional policy approach is to allow domestic retail prices to align with international prices while protecting the most vulnerable. However, many countries intervene in price settings to shield their domestic markets from global fluctuations. This paper provides a comprehensive assessment of the passthrough from global to domestic retail prices for four commodities: gasoline, diesel, wheat, and rice over the past two decades in many countries. We employ a dynamic model of local projections building on the work of Kpodar and Abdallah (2017). Our findings indicate that average passthrough is incomplete, with fuel exhibiting higher and faster passthrough than food. The extent of passthrough varies by period, region, and between commodity exporters and importers. We also examine asymmetric responses to global price shocks and find evidence of a ratchet effect: price increases are more likely to be passed through than decreases.
abstract_zh: 燃料和食品在消费者支出篮子中占据重要份额，但其价格波动剧烈。2026年3月，受地缘政治动荡和供应限制影响，新一轮能源价格冲击凸显了国际价格冲击如何传导至国内市场的宏观经济效应与分配效应。此类价格飙升可能产生重大的社会、政治和经济影响。传统政策路径是允许国内零售价格与国际价格接轨，同时保护最脆弱群体。然而，许多国家通过干预价格设定来隔离国内市场免受全球波动影响。本文对过去二十年间多个国家四种大宗商品（汽油、柴油、小麦和大米）从全球到国内零售价格的传导机制进行了全面评估。我们基于Kpodar和Abdallah（2017）的研究构建了局部投影动态模型。研究结果表明，平均传导效应不完全，其中燃料的传导速度和幅度均高于食品。传导程度因时期、区域以及大宗商品出口国与进口国之间的差异而有所不同。我们还考察了对全球价格冲击的非对称反应，并发现了棘轮效应的证据：价格上涨比下跌更易被传导。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为多国数据，未明确提及中国、中国企业或中国政策背景。
title: Pumps and Plates: Passthrough of International Fuel and Food Price Shocks to Domestic Markets
title_zh: 泵与盘：国际燃料与食品价格冲击对国内市场的传导

abstract: The recent inflation surge brought inflation back on people’s minds. I quantify when and how much attention to inflation changes and derive the macroeconomic implications of these attention changes. I estimate an attention threshold at an inflation rate of 4 percent, that attention doubles when inflation exceeds this threshold, and that supply shocks have stronger and more persistent effects on inflation in times of high attention. Developing a model featuring the attention threshold, I show that attention changes offer a joint explanation for inflation surges, inflation’s co-movement with inflation expectations, and a long last mile of disinflation.
abstract_zh: 近期通胀飙升使人们重新关注通货膨胀。我量化了通胀关注度何时发生变化及其变化幅度，并推导出这些关注度变化对宏观经济的影响。我估算出通胀关注度的阈值为4%的通胀率——当通胀超过这一阈值时，关注度会翻倍——且在高关注度时期，供给冲击对通胀的影响更强且更持久。通过构建一个包含关注度阈值的模型，我证明关注度变化能够共同解释通胀飙升、通胀与通胀预期的联动关系，以及去通胀进程中“最后一公里”的漫长过程。
title: The Inflation Attention Threshold and Inflation Surges
title_zh: 通胀关注阈值与通胀激增

abstract: We study the causal effects of global supply chain disruptions by constructing a new index of real-time port congestion using Automatic Identification System data from container ships and a spatial clustering algorithm. We develop a model with search frictions between producers and retailers that links upstream production slack to downstream supply shortages and captures output and price responses to supply chain shocks. The co-movements of output, prices, spare capacity, and market tightness provide novel identification restrictions. We find demand and supply shocks drove US disinflation in 2020, while the inflation surge in 2021 was driven mainly by supply chain shocks.
abstract_zh: 我们通过利用集装箱船舶的自动识别系统数据与空间聚类算法，构建了一个实时港口拥堵指数，以此研究全球供应链中断的因果效应。我们建立了一个包含生产商与零售商之间搜索摩擦的模型，该模型将上游生产闲置与下游供应短缺联系起来，并捕捉了产出和价格对供应链冲击的反应。产出、价格、闲置产能和市场紧度的协同变动提供了新的识别约束条件。研究发现，2020年美国通胀放缓主要由需求与供给冲击驱动，而2021年的通胀飙升则主要源于供应链冲击。
title: The Causal Effects of Global Supply Chain Disruptions on Macroeconomic Outcomes: Evidence and Theory
title_zh: 全球供应链中断对宏观经济结果的因果效应：证据与理论
